source.description:
## GOAL

Prepare xtmux for release + public consumption. Currently solo-dev, direct-to-main
FF workflow; when this ships, others will need to install, upgrade, and read
what changed.

## OUT-OF-SCOPE (deferred to release-time)

- Actual v1.0 tag + release publish action.
- Branch protection + PR-required rules on main (operator's flip once ready).
source.notes:
IMPLEMENTATION READY (not published): @jaggerxtrm/xtmux 0.1.0 installer, global Pi/Claude integration, reusable git-cliff/aicommit2 assets, docs, MIT metadata, npm provenance workflow, and strict package contents implemented. Validation: npm test PASS (183 Bun + 179 shell contract + 2 installer); typecheck PASS; npm audit --omit=dev 0 vulnerabilities; final packed artifact smoke PASS from /tmp artifact with clean global install, 11 Claude wrappers, grouped Pi package, idempotent reinstall, live backend, no browser, external-repo changelog; package 68 files/~120KB/no dev dotdirs. Live ~/.pi and ~/.claude installation applied and idempotency verified; 12 xtrm-global wrappers plus unrelated settings preserved. Epic remains open only for xtmux-5j3.7, a non-blocking upstream specialists-repo callout that cannot be vendored here without violating its hash ownership gate. Full mapping: docs/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md.
Final real-user install: installed the tested tarball globally with npm (not published). npm list -g shows @jaggerxtrm/xtmux@0.1.0; ~/.local/bin targets the stable npm global package, live V2 JSON query succeeds, Pi lists the grouped package, Claude has 11 xtmux wrappers while all 12 xtrm-global wrappers remain.
Pane 1 follow-up xtmux-qa0 integrated and closed: shell prefilters registered (10.69ms vs 58.64ms direct Node no-match), stale .xtrm auto-monitor duplicates deleted, expanded settings merge tests green, final packed + real global install refreshed, and xt update survival re-verified.
P0 E integrated: xtmux-obs uses a Node shim resolving vendored Bun, not /usr/bin/env bun. Packed and real global installs pass direct/picker JSON commands with system Bun excluded from PATH. qa0 reclosed after 193+179+5 tests and typecheck.
Coverage-completion commit 772b595 pushed to PR #20: existing Codex installs get agent-state hooks without installing Codex CLI; npm ships keys.md and INSTALL includes required tmux binding; README skill claim corrected.
